records.name: Turmeric
records.description: A rhizome used fresh or dried as a spice.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: Provides dietary fibre and plant compounds such as curcuminoids.
cautions: Culinary amounts are different from concentrated supplements.
High-dose turmeric supplements can interact with medicines.
records.servingSuggestions: Use in curries, dal, vegetables and warm beverages.
records.selectionTips: Choose clean, aromatic powder or firm fresh rhizomes.
records.storageTips: Keep powder dry and airtight; refrigerate fresh rhizome.

records.name: Cumin
records.description: Aromatic seed used whole or ground.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: Provides fibre and minerals in small culinary amounts.
cautions: Culinary amounts are small; nutrition contribution is limited per serving.
records.servingSuggestions: Use for tempering, spice blends and curries.
records.selectionTips: Choose aromatic seeds without moisture or infestation.
records.storageTips: Store airtight away from heat and moisture.

records.name: Black Pepper
records.description: Dried peppercorn used whole or ground.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: Provides plant compounds and flavour, allowing less reliance on heavy sauces.
cautions: May irritate some people with reflux or gastrointestinal sensitivity.
records.servingSuggestions: Use freshly ground in savoury dishes.

records.name: Cinnamon
records.description: Aromatic bark used in sweet and savoury dishes.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: Provides dietary fibre and aromatic plant compounds.
cautions: Large supplemental doses are not the same as culinary use; cassia cinnamon can contain significant coumarin.
records.servingSuggestions: Use small culinary amounts in curries, oats or beverages.
records.selectionTips: Choose aromatic sticks or powder from a reputable source.

records.name: Ginger
records.description: Fresh rhizome used for flavouring and cooking.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: Commonly used in cooking and beverages.
cautions: Large supplemental amounts may cause gastrointestinal discomfort or interact with some medicines.
records.servingSuggestions: Use fresh in curries, soups, tea and stir-fries.
records.selectionTips: Choose firm, smooth rhizomes without mould.

records.name: Garlic
records.description: Bulb used as a seasoning and ingredient.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: Provides plant compounds and small amounts of vitamin C.
cautions: Can cause digestive discomfort or heartburn in some people.
May interact with anticoagulant medicines in concentrated amounts.
records.servingSuggestions: Use fresh in curries, chutneys and stir-fries.
records.selectionTips: Choose firm bulbs without mould or sprouting damage.
records.storageTips: Store in a cool, dry, ventilated place.
